compose-config.description: Validate the Docker Compose file without starting anything. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires docker compose. Creates the workspace-root .env from .env.default when it is missing (the documented bootstrap; .env is gitignored) and never touches an existing one. Uncached on purpose: the compose file reads the workspace-root .env (env_file), which is gitignored and so cannot be declared as an input, and a cached pass would replay after .env goes missing or changes.

helm-lint.description: Lint every Helm chart under helm/ against its base values. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Requires helm on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; the GitHub-hosted runners ship it).

options.command: for chart in {projectRoot}/helm/*/; do helm lint "$chart" --values "$chart/values/base.yaml" || exit 1; done

helm-test.description: Run the helm-unittest suites under every chart that has a tests folder. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Installs the helm-unittest v1.2.1 plugin when helm plugin list lacks unittest, for Linux amd64 or arm64 (the architecture picks its tarball, and any other platform fails before downloading). The tarball must match its hard-coded sha256 (that check is the integrity gate; both hashes match the release's helm-unittest-checksum.sha), then is copied into the plugins directory without its install hook, which would download the tarball again. Requires helm, curl, and sha256sum on PATH.

options.command: helm plugin list | awk 'NR > 1 { print $1 }' | grep -qx unittest || { case "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" in Linux-x86_64) a=amd64; s=48e86ecc1467b009630e5954375e5d8494139f73b466df5fe8c04fa45b634939;; Linux-aarch64|Linux-arm64) a=arm64; s=c66062713cd3cbb1a80d7098bd1d4a48db8438f56b43fb6377df65447f93f8de;; *) echo 'unsupported platform for the helm-unittest plugin: Linux amd64 or arm64 only' >&2; exit 1;; esac && d=$(mktemp -d) && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL -o "$d/helm-unittest.tgz" "https://github.com/helm-unittest/helm-unittest/releases/download/v1.2.1/helm-unittest-linux-$a-1.2.1.tgz" && echo "$s  $d/helm-unittest.tgz" | sha256sum -c - && mkdir "$d/plugin" && tar xzf "$d/helm-unittest.tgz" -C "$d/plugin" && sed -i '/^platformHooks:/,$d' "$d/plugin/plugin.yaml" && mkdir -p "$(helm env HELM_PLUGINS)/unittest" && cp -R "$d/plugin/." "$(helm env HELM_PLUGINS)/unittest/"; status=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; }; for chart in {projectRoot}/helm/*/; do if [ -d "$chart/tests" ]; then helm unittest "$chart" || exit 1; fi; done

open-webui.description: Manage the Open WebUI Docker service (up, down, open)

recreate.command: docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v postgres && docker compose -f {projectRoot}/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres

postgres.description: Start, stop, or recreate the local PostgreSQL container (recreate removes the volume)

searxng.description: Manage the SearxNG Docker service (up, down, open)

terraform-apply.description: Apply a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, linode, kubernetes, or bootstrap), creating, updating, and deleting what a fresh plan finds. Needs the terraform-plan variables. Run by the Continuous Deployment workflow on main; run it locally only on purpose.

terraform-format.description: Check that the OpenRouter, GitHub, Linode, Kubernetes, and Bootstrap Terraform is formatted. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; CI uses hashicorp/setup-terraform).

options.command: terraform fmt -check -diff -recursive openrouter github kubernetes bootstrap linode

terraform-init.description: Initialize a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, linode, kubernetes, or bootstrap) against its Linode Object Storage backend. Needs TF_STATE_BUCKET, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

terraform-plan.description: Plan a Terraform root (--configuration=openrouter, github, linode, kubernetes, or bootstrap) and write plan.tfplan beside it, without changing anything. Needs the terraform-init variables plus TF_VAR_openrouter_management_key.

terraform-test.description: Run the Terraform unit tests of every root under terraform/ that has a tests folder, against mock providers. Part of lint-code, so the Lint leg of continuous-integration.yml runs it. Needs no credentials: each root is initialized with -backend=false, so only the provider download needs network access. Requires terraform on PATH.

options.command: for root in */; do if [ -d "$root/tests" ]; then (cd "$root" && terraform init -input=false -backend=false && terraform test) || exit 1; fi; done

terraform-validate.description: Validate the OpenRouter, GitHub, Linode, Kubernetes, and Bootstrap Terraform without a backend or credentials. Part of lint-code. Requires terraform on PATH and downloads the provider, so it needs network access.

options.command: for module in openrouter github kubernetes bootstrap linode; do (cd $module && terraform init -input=false -backend=false && terraform validate) || exit 1; done

trivy-config.description: Scan Terraform infrastructure code for misconfigurations using Trivy. Identical to what the Secure check runs, so a local run reproduces CI exactly. Requires trivy on PATH (the devcontainer installs it; otherwise `brew install trivy`).
